items.title: Warranty & returns
items.description: Reconditioned engines carry a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty; used engines state their own term on every listing. Return any engine uninstalled within 14 days for a full refund including original delivery.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: UK mainland delivery by kerbside pallet, typically 2-4 working days for in-stock units, with tracking emailed on dispatch. The delivery price shown at checkout is the price you pay.
